description: Check a cryptocurrency address offline before using it: Bitcoin legacy/P2SH (base58check), segwit/taproot (bech32/bech32m), Ethereum and all EVM chains incl. Base (EIP-55 checksum via keccak-256), Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron and Solana. Returns valid, chain, network, type, and the correctly checksummed form. Catches typos and copy errors.
name: crypto_address_validate
title: Validate a crypto address (BTC, EVM, SOL, LTC, DOGE, TRX)
